mentions.name: SimplyThings
mentions.description: A Mac todo app with lots of neat keyboard shortcuts and a hotkey window, letting users quickly add and cross off tasks without disrupting their focus.
mentions.problem: Existing todo apps are bloated and can ruin focus while working; the author wanted a quick way to add and cross tasks off.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on (yes, yet another one) Todo app that has a lot of neat keyboard shortcuts and a useful hotkey window on Mac.
mentions.author: danard
